game_gpu_sub: Graphics level, rendering mode and anti-aliasing used by Roblox.
game_gpu_next_launch: Rendering mode and MSAA apply the next time Roblox opens.
game_texture_sub: Forces a lower texture quality, which can raise FPS on weaker PCs. Applies the next time Roblox opens.
game_voxel_sub: Stops Roblox from updating the voxel lighting, which can raise FPS. Lighting may look less accurate. Applies the next time Roblox opens.
game_dpi_sub: Roblox ignores the Windows display scaling and renders at your real resolution (sharper on high-DPI screens). Applies the next time Roblox opens.
game_rejoin_sub: If Roblox disconnects you for being idle or because your internet dropped, Rainbow Client reopens Roblox in the same server. Private servers are not rejoined.
game_captures_sub: Blocks the Roblox screenshot and video recording features. Their hotkeys stop working while blocked. Files you already saved are kept.
game_captures_failed_msg: Close Roblox and any program using the Roblox folder in Pictures or Videos, then try again.
rejoin_toast_msg: You were disconnected. Rejoining the same server...
rejoin_toast_failed: Couldn't reopen Roblox to rejoin the server.
general_startup_sub: Choose what Rainbow Client does when you turn on your computer.
general_startup_auto_sub: Rainbow Client opens as soon as you turn on your computer.
general_startup_min_sub: Rainbow Client opens in the background, minimized to the taskbar.
general_startup_off_sub: Rainbow Client only opens when you start it yourself.

general_reset_sub: Restores every Rainbow Client setting to its default and restarts the client. Your key, language, downloaded versions, mods and profiles are kept.
